About

Building Django systems that hold up in the real world.

I'm an Information Systems student at DMMMSU–NLUC Bacnotan, working across Django development, relational databases, and role-based systems. I build applications for student housing and campus attendance — from models and migrations to the screens people actually use.

Both systems run on Python, Django and MySQL over XAMPP, with a shared glassmorphism design language. I write automated tests, seed data and system diagrams so a fresh install is usable and the next person can pick it up.

Selected workThings I've built
BH
01 — Boarding house system

BHIMS

A boarding house listing and booking system for students near DMMMSU–NLUC. Landlords post listings with photos, rates and amenities; admins moderate every listing before it goes public; students filter by barangay and price, message landlords in a thread, and get confirmed bookings.

Django 6.0MySQLXAMPPBootstrap 5PillowPower BI
GitHub profile
CP
02 — Campus presence system

CIS-Prox

A campus attendance and presence system. Students sign in and out of rooms and laboratories, classmates see who is currently where, and instructors get dashboards for class attendance, reports and broadcasts. Privacy controls and a campus Wi-Fi gate keep check-ins tied to the actual campus network.

Approach · 01

Roles and permissions before the first view.

Database-first system design

Christian Jade Badua · Django · MySQL

Every system starts with the data: models, relationships and migrations first, then the role-based views that guard them. Student, landlord and admin permissions are mapped before a screen is built, so the interface makes the rules obvious instead of confusing.

Approach · 02

Tested, not guessed.

Automated tests + seed data

Christian Jade Badua · 73 tests

Every flow is covered by Django's test runner — role access, booking and sign-in/out rules, and adversarial cases. Migrations and seed data mean a fresh XAMPP install is usable immediately, and four architecture diagrams document how the pieces fit together.
